name: openmagnetics-mcp-app
description: OpenMagnetics MCP App — the sweep-curves, design-picker, wound-coil and result-panel widgets

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && for w in curves picker coil result; do INPUT=$w.html vite build || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
